explanation: The router runs one navigation attempt at a time. begin(policy) retires the attempt in flight, clears routePending and routeError and sets the write policy: replace for a followed URL, push for a user action, hold after an ignored fragment until the target hash changes; the write effect consumes it on a write, a matching hash or a refusal. hasWritten, the replaceNextWrite stop-gap and the retired-landing replaceState are gone. Verbs and view-reported setters (on a real change only) start push attempts, openInExplorer(id, track) verifies through landRoute and settleExplorer, and App calls the new stable supersede() before its track, tab, contrast, leave-Compare and send-genes navigate calls.
